<!--
Thanks for contributing! Please keep pull requests focused on one logical change.
See CONTRIBUTING.md for the full guidelines.
-->

## What & why

What does this change do, and what problem does it solve? Link any related issue
(e.g. `Fixes #123`).

## How it was tested

How did you verify the change? (Commands run, scenarios covered.)

## Checklist

- [ ] `go test ./...` passes
- [ ] `go vet ./...` is clean
- [ ] Code is `gofmt`-formatted
- [ ] New behavior is covered by tests (and fixes include a regression test)
- [ ] Docs updated where behavior, commands, config, or the security surface changed
- [ ] The change keeps the agent featherweight and respects the OS-abstraction boundary
